protocol.name: linux_mirror_stereo_v1
protocol.copyright: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT Linux Mirror stereo buffer annotation protocol
protocol.description:
This protocol lets a Wayland client annotate a surface as carrying a side-by-side (SBS) stereo buffer. For an SBS surface the committed buffer is exactly twice the logical surface width: the left half holds the left-eye image and the right half holds the right-eye image.
Compositors that do not implement this protocol render the surface normally (the full buffer is scaled into the logical viewport). Compositors that do implement it can expose the annotation to capture pipelines, which use it to set BufferLayout::SbsStereo on the SourceSurfaceInfo delivered to presenters.
Receivers that do not support stereo MUST render only the left half of an sbs_stereo buffer, scaled to the logical surface dimensions. Squashing the full 2x buffer into the logical viewport is prohibited.

interface.name: lm_stereo_manager_v1
interface.description: Singleton object used to create per-surface stereo annotations. Bind it from the registry; there is at most one per compositor.

request.name: get_stereo_surface

description.summary: create a stereo annotation for a surface

request.description: Create an lm_stereo_surface_v1 annotation object for the given wl_surface. The caller must not call get_stereo_surface for the same surface more than once; doing so raises the already_annotated protocol error.

entry.name: already_annotated
entry.summary: get_stereo_surface was called twice for the same surface

interface.name: lm_stereo_surface_v1

description.summary: stereo layout annotation for a surface

interface.description: Describes the stereo buffer layout for an annotated surface. Call set_layout before the first wl_surface.commit so the compositor sees the annotation before the surface maps.

request.name: set_layout

description.summary: declare the buffer layout for this surface

request.description: Set the buffer layout. For sbs_stereo, every buffer committed to the associated wl_surface must be exactly 2 * logical_width wide; the left half [0, logical_width) is the left-eye image, and the right half [logical_width, 2*logical_width) is the right-eye image.

entry.name: mono
entry.summary: standard single-view buffer; buffer width == surface width

entry.name: sbs_stereo
entry.summary: side-by-side stereo; buffer width == 2 * surface width
